responsibility: This file is the main type-construction and type-query layer for the GNU Modula-2 frontend. It creates and canonicalizes GCC tree types for Modula-2 scalar, pointer, array, set, record, union, variant, enumeration, subrange, function, and constructor forms; initializes the frontend’s built-in Modula-2 and ISO/system types; manages constructor stacks for aggregate constants; and provides type-range, signedness, size, and address-type helpers, making it the core owner of gm2 type nodes and aggregate type lowering.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2type family: it owns the actual GCC tree-building logic, canonicalization state, predefined type-node storage, and helper routines behind the APIs declared in m2type.h and exported to Modula-2 via m2type.def.
